chunks: Dawud ibn Abi Yazid asked him:
about a water container, a pair of sandals, and a whip that a man finds on the road: may he make use of it?
He said: "He should not touch it."

key_terms.الْإِدَاوَةِ: a water container or small vessel for carrying water
key_terms.لَا يَمَسَّهُ: he should not touch or take hold of it

ai.seo_question: Can a person use a water container, sandals, or a whip found on the road?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding found property on the road, such as a water container, sandals, or a whip. The Imam عليه السلام forbids taking or using such items, indicating caution regarding the property rights of others and avoidance of unlawful appropriation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4055 - Dawud ibn Abi Yazid asked him
about finding a water container, a pair of sandals, or a whip on the road, whether a person may use them.
Imam (as) said: "He should not touch them."
